A few short questions, one at a time. They only choose starting settings and which supports to put forward. You can change everything later.

Focus sessions
How should sessions start by default?

You can still change this before every session. After three measured completions, the app can suggest a local reference: it keeps the longest eligible active duration, rounds it up to the next minute, then adds one minute of margin. That reference is never forced.

What may the app do without making you think about it?
Only local, explicit and reversible behaviours. Adaptation uses visible rules — energy, available time and context — not a hidden profile. Turn off anything that would get in your way.
